text:
zoe: Planning a regional unpin for runtime-2.18 in eu-north tonight 22:00 UTC. Keeping a minimal safelist for accounts with longseq kvcache ties.

mike: Can we be explicit about which models stay pinned? Last-minute surprises caused a customer incident.

deploybot: [deploybot] preview diff:
```diff
-  - model: gpt-legacy
-    reason: longseq-kv-ref
+  - model: gpt-legacy
+    reason: remains pinned for enterprise eu-north
+  - model: llama-mini-old
+    reason: customer-specific pin
```

tara: Rollback thresholds proposal: p95 >15% vs baseline for 5m OR error-rate >2% sustained for 5m. Auto-fallback to runtime-2.17 for canary cohort.

sre-oncall: I'll add dashboards for kv-cache hit-rate, pod OOMs, and connection-pool saturation. If autoscaler cycles >4 in 10m, we abort.

emike: SDK gate: SDK v3.7 must pass the binding smoke at 21:15 UTC. @tara can you run it?

tara: Yep, will run tokenization + reconnect tests at 21:15 and post results.

zoe: Quick rollback commands if needed:
```bash
# rollback to pinned runtime
deploybot rollback --region eu-north --runtime 2.17 --reason "post-unpin regression"
# reapply model pin
deploybot pin add --region eu-north --model gpt-legacy --note "re-pin on regression"
```

deploybot: [deploybot] change staged. React :white_check_mark: to approve; :x: to hold. Applies at 22:00 UTC if >=2 approvals.

tara: SDK smoke: PASS. No tokenization diffs, connection pool stable.

mike: Approving. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: Approving and standing by. :white_check_mark:

zoe: Rolling at 22:00 UTC. Will monitor for 2 hours post-lift and update CS if any dedicated accounts are affected.
